```{r load}
# Busca .mamba_root/envs/py311/python.exe desde getwd() hacia padres
find_python_rel <- function(start = getwd(),
                            rel = file.path(".mamba_root","envs","py311","python.exe")) {
  cur <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    cand <- normalizePath(file.path(cur, rel), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    if (file.exists(cand)) return(cand)
    parent <- dirname(cur)
    if (identical(parent, cur)) return(NA_character_)  # llegó a la raíz
    cur <- parent
  }
}
```

```{r setup}
check_quarto_version <- function(required = "1.7.29", comparator = c("ge","gt","le","lt","eq")) {
  comparator <- match.arg(comparator)
  current <- package_version(paste(unlist(quarto::quarto_version()), collapse = "."))
  req     <- package_version(required)

  ok <- switch(comparator,
               ge = current >= req,
               gt = current >  req,
               le = current <= req,
               lt = current <  req,
               eq = current == req)

  if (!ok) {
    stop(sprintf("Quarto version check failed: need %s %s (installed: %s).",
                 comparator, required, current), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

as.data.frame.TableOne <- function(x, ...) {
  capture.output(print(x, showAllLevels = TRUE, varLabels = T,...) -> x)
  y <- as.data.frame(x)
  y$characteristic <- dplyr::na_if(rownames(x), "")
  y <- y|> 
    tidyr::fill(characteristic, .direction = "down")|>
    dplyr::select(characteristic, everything())
  rownames(y) <- NULL
  y}


tidy_iiw_by_plan <- function(models_by_plan,
                             conf.level = 0.95,
                             digits = 3,
                             drop_cluster = TRUE,
                             sort = c("none","plan_term"),
                             return_tidytable = FALSE) {
  sort <- match.arg(sort)

  # preserve the incoming order of plan types
  plan_levels <- names(models_by_plan) %||% seq_along(models_by_plan)

  out <- purrr::imap_dfr(models_by_plan, function(x, plan_lbl) {
    fit <- if (!is.null(x$m)) x$m else x

    tbl <- broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE,
                       conf.level = conf.level)

    if (drop_cluster) {
      tbl <- dplyr::filter(tbl, !grepl("cluster\\(", term))
    }

    # keep broom's original row order
        tbl <- tbl %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            .term_order = dplyr::row_number(),
            plan_type   = plan_lbl,
            HR          = round(estimate, digits),
            CI_low      = round(conf.low, digits),
            CI_high     = round(conf.high, digits),
            CI95 = sprintf( paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f)"), as.numeric(HR), as.numeric(CI_low), as.numeric(CI_high) ),
            p           = sprintf("%1.4f", signif(p.value, 3)),
          ) %>%
          dplyr::select(plan_type, .term_order, term, CI95, p)

  })

  # optional sorting
  if (sort == "plan_term") {
    out <- out %>%
      dplyr::mutate(plan_type = factor(plan_type, levels = plan_levels)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(plan_type, .term_order)
  } else {
    # no reordering: keep original list order & term order
    out <- out %>%
      dplyr::mutate(plan_type = factor(plan_type, levels = plan_levels)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(as.integer(plan_type), .term_order)
  }

  out <- out %>% tidytable::select(-.term_order)

  if (return_tidytable) {
    out <- tidytable::as_tidytable(as.data.frame(out))  # robust conversion
  }

  out
}
```

## Upset plot

```{r upset_plot}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hold"

# 2. assume your data.frame is called `df`
#    with columns: hash_key, otras_sus1_mod, otras_sus2_mod, otras_sus3_mod

# 3. pivot to long (one row per participant–substance), drop NAs
df_long <- dat_with_weights_stab_cons |>
  tidytable::arrange(hash_key, adm_age_rec3) |>
  tidytable::slice_head(n = 1, .by = hash_key) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    susprindum = dplyr::case_when(
      susprindum_mar == 1 ~ "Marijuana",
      susprindum_oh  == 1 ~ "Alcohol",
      susprindum_pbc == 1 ~ "Cocaine paste",
      susprindum_coc == 1 ~ "Cocaine hydrochloride",
      susprindum_oth == 1 ~ "Other",
      TRUE               ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    hash_key,
    primary_sub,
    second_sub1,
    second_sub2,
    second_sub3
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate_at(
    c(
      "primary_sub",
      "second_sub1",
      "second_sub2",
      "second_sub3"
    ),
    ~ dplyr::if_else(
      . %in% c(
        "dissociatives",
        "hallucinogens",
        "inhalants",
        "amphetamine-type stimulants",
        "opioids",
        "tranquilizers/hypnotics",
        "sin sustancia principal (cip-crc)",
        "others"
      ),
      "others",
      .
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -hash_key,
    names_to = "which_other",
    values_to = "substance",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

# 4. make an incidence (wide) matrix of 0/1
df_incidence <- df_long %>% 
  dplyr::distinct(hash_key, substance) %>%      # one row per use
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from   = substance,
    values_from  = present,
    values_fill  = list(present = 0)
  )

df_upset <- df_incidence %>%
  dplyr::select(-hash_key) %>%            # remove the ID column
  as.data.frame()                  # coerce tibble → base data.frame

names(df_upset) <- make.names(names(df_upset))


# 5. run upset()
library(UpSetR)
upset(
  df_upset,
  sets        = names(df_upset), # all columns
  order.by    = "freq",
  mb.ratio    = c(0.6, 0.4),
  main.bar.color = "black",
  sets.bar.color = "black",
  matrix.color   = "black",
  text.scale     = c(2, 2, 2, 1.5, 1.5, 1)
)

png("my_upset_plot_26.png", width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)
upset(
  df_upset,

  sets.bar.color = "black",
  matrix.color   = "black",
  text.scale     = c(2, 2, 2, 1.5, 1.5, 1)
)
dev.off()
```

```{r table_one}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hold"

# database cons, one tr or more -------------------------------------------


as.data.frame.TableOne <- function(x, ...) {
  capture.output(print(x, showAllLevels = TRUE, varLabels = T,...) -> x)
  y <- as.data.frame(x)
  y$characteristic <- dplyr::na_if(rownames(x), "")

cat("After discarding Any treatment w/ death or ongoing tr")
length(unique(SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient$hash_key))
#[1] 118594

##_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#
## TableOne (polysubstance strata) — tidy + applied to SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient
##_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#


df <- SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient

# 1) Pick strata variable automatically
strata_var <- if ("polysubstance_strict" %in% names(df)) "polysubstance_strict" else "polysubstance"

# 2) Variables of interest
vars_interest <- c(
  "tr_noncompletion",
  "biopsych_comp_severe",
  "treat_lt_90",
  "treat_log_days",
  "adm_age_rec3",
  "year_decimal",
  "sus_ini_mod_mvv",
  "dg_psiq_cie_10_dg",
  "dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy",
  "prim_sub_daily",
  "occupation_condition_corr24",
  "primary_sub_mod"
)

# 3) Which of those should be treated as categorical
factorVars_interest <- c(
  "biopsych_comp_severe",
  "sus_ini_mod_mvv",
  "dg_psiq_cie_10_dg",
  "dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy",
  "prim_sub_daily",
  "occupation_condition_corr24",
  "primary_sub_mod",
  "tr_noncompletion",
  "treat_lt_90"
)

# 4) Labels (stored as attributes in the data; CreateTableOne doesn’t consume them directly)
attr(df$tr_noncompletion,           "label") <- "Non-completion status of treatment (Dropout / Misspelled)"
attr(df$biopsych_comp_severe,       "label") <- "Biopsychosocial compromise (Severe)"
attr(df$treat_lt_90,                "label") <- "Treatment duration (binary) (<90 days)"
attr(df$treat_log_days,             "label") <- "Treatment duration (log-scaled days)"
attr(df$adm_age_rec3,               "label") <- "Age at admission to treatment"
attr(df$year_decimal,               "label") <- "Birth year"
attr(df$sus_ini_mod_mvv,            "label") <- "Primary substance (initial diagnosis)"
attr(df$dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy,     "label") <- "Psychiatric comorbidity (ICD-10): In study"
attr(df$dg_psiq_cie_10_dg,          "label") <- "Psychiatric comorbidity (ICD-10): Diagnosis"
attr(df$prim_sub_daily,             "label") <- "Daily frequency of primary substance used at admission"
attr(df$occupation_condition_corr24,"label") <- "Occupational Status"
attr(df$primary_sub_mod,            "label") <- "Primary substance at admission to treatment"

# 5) Build analysis frame (NO slice_head; keep one row per hash_key if needed)
vars_needed <- unique(c(vars_interest, strata_var))

data_tbone <- df |>
  tidytable::select(tidytable::all_of(vars_needed)) |>
  (\(x) if ("hash_key" %in% names(x)) tidytable::distinct(x, hash_key, .keep_all = TRUE) else x)()

# 6) Create TableOne
tbone_interest <- tableone::CreateTableOne(
  vars         = vars_interest,
  data         = data_tbone,
  factorVars = factorVars_interest,
  strata     = strata_var,
  addOverall = TRUE,
  includeNA  = TRUE,
  smd        = TRUE,
  test       = TRUE
)

# 7) Export as data.frame
df_tbone <- as.data.frame.TableOne(
  tbone_interest,
  nonnormal = c("adm_age_rec3", "year_decimal", "treat_log_days"),
  smd        = TRUE
)

# 8) Desired order (characteristic + level)
order_df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~characteristic, ~level,
  "n", "",
  "Non-completion status of treatment (Dropout / Misspelled) (%)", "0",
  "Non-completion status of treatment (Dropout / Misspelled) (%)", "1",
  "Biopsychosocial compromise (Severe) (%)", "0",
  "Biopsychosocial compromise (Severe) (%)", "1",
  "Biopsychosocial compromise (Severe) (%)", NA,
  "Treatment duration (binary) (<90 days) (%)", "0",
  "Treatment duration (binary) (<90 days) (%)", "1",
  "Treatment duration (log-scaled days) (median [IQR])", "",
  "Age at admission to treatment (median [IQR])", "",
  "Birth year (median [IQR])", "",
  "Primary substance (initial diagnosis) (%)", "cocaine powder",
  "Primary substance (initial diagnosis) (%)", "cocaine paste",
  "Primary substance (initial diagnosis) (%)", "marijuana",
  "Primary substance (initial diagnosis) (%)", "alcohol",
  "Primary substance (initial diagnosis) (%)", "others",
  "Primary substance (initial diagnosis) (%)", NA,
  "Psychiatric comorbidity (ICD-10): In study (%)", "TRUE",
  "Psychiatric comorbidity (ICD-10): In study (%)", "FALSE",
  "Psychiatric comorbidity (ICD-10): Diagnosis (%)", "TRUE",
  "Daily frequency of primary substance used at admission (%)", "0",
  "Daily frequency of primary substance used at admission (%)", "1",
  "Daily frequency of primary substance used at admission (%)", NA,
  "Occupational Status (%)", "inactive",
  "Occupational Status (%)", "unemployed",
  "Occupational Status (%)", "employed",
  "Primary substance at admission to treatment (%)", "cocaine powder",
  "Primary substance at admission to treatment (%)", "cocaine paste",
  "Primary substance at admission to treatment (%)", "marijuana",
  "Primary substance at admission to treatment (%)", "alcohol",
  "Primary substance at admission to treatment (%)", "others"
) |>
  tidytable::mutate(order_id = dplyr::row_number())

# 9) Join order + arrange (keep only rows that exist in order_df; drop the helper column)
df_tbone_ordered <- df_tbone |>
  tidytable::left_join(order_df, by = c("characteristic", "level")) |>
  tidytable::arrange(order_id) |>
  tidytable::select(-order_id)

# df_tbone_ordered is your final ordered table

head(df_tbone_ordered)
```

### Imputation

This script selects which variables to impute, builds a multivariate formula to impute them using random forest + PMM, runs missRanger on a safe subset, then merges back only the imputed columns into the full dataset, and finally displays an OOB summary of the error by variable.

```{r imputation}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hold"

set.seed(2125)

# Keep only variables that actually exist to avoid errors
vars_impute <- intersect(vars_impute, names(df))
if (length(vars_impute) == 0) stop("None of the vars in vars_interest/polysubstance_strict/plan_type_mod exist in the data.")

#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
# 1) Predictors (you can expand/trim this list as you prefer)
#    Tip: include easy, generally-available covariates to make MAR more plausible
#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
predictor_pool <- c(
  # strong helpers already in your dataset
  "adm_age_rec3", "year_decimal", "treat_log_days", "treat_lt_90",
  "biopsych_comp_severe", "tr_noncompletion", "prim_sub_daily",
  "primary_sub_mod", "occupation_condition_corr24",
  "pub_center", "type_center", "episodes",
  "sex_rec", "plan_type_mod", "primary_sub_std", "tr_completion",
  "dg_psiq_cie_10_dg", "dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy", 
  "episodes", "age_subs_onset_rec2", "age_primary_onset_rec2",
  "tenure_status_household", "macrozone_center", "adm_motive",
  "marital_status", "ed_attainment", "sub_dep_icd10_status", "pub_center", "senda", "num_trat_ant", 
  "fecha_ultimo_tratamiento"
)

# Use only columns that exist
predictor_pool <- intersect(unique(c(predictor_pool, vars_impute)), names(df))

# Make sure we still have something on the RHS
if (length(predictor_pool) == 0) stop("No predictors found in the data. Please add some predictor names that exist.")

#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
# 2) Build formula: (targets) ~ (predictors)
#    missRanger will impute ONLY the LHS variables
#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
lhs <- paste(vars_impute, collapse = " + ")
rhs <- paste(predictor_pool, collapse = " + ")
form_miss <- as.formula(paste(lhs, "~", rhs))

#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
# 3) Arrange for reproducibility and run missRanger
#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
post_df_ord <- dplyr::arrange(df, hash_key, adm_date_num_rec2)

# columns to pass to missRanger = targets (impute) + predictors
post_cols_mr <- unique(c(vars_impute, predictor_pool))

# subset safely whether dat_ord is data.table/tidytable or data.frame
if (inherits(post_df_ord, "data.table")) {
  post_df_sub <- post_df_ord[, ..post_cols_mr]
} else {
  # fallback for data.frame / tibble
  post_df_sub <- post_df_ord[, post_cols_mr, drop = FALSE]
}

# (optional) force to plain data.frame to avoid method dispatch surprises
post_df_sub <- as.data.frame(post_df_sub)

post_SISTRAT_imputed_only <- missRanger::missRanger(
  data      = post_df_sub,         # << use the safe subset
  formula   = form_miss,        # ONLY LHS vars in vars_impute will be imputed
  num.trees = 100,
  pmm.k     = 5,
  maxiter   = 50,
  returnOOB = TRUE,
  verbose   = 2,
  seed      = 2125
)

#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
# 4) Write imputed values back to your full data
#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
# Make safe copies as data.frame
post_SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient_multiple_imp <- as.data.frame(post_df_ord)
post_SISTRAT_imputed_only_df <- as.data.frame(post_SISTRAT_imputed_only)

# Regular data.frame column replacement works with a character vector of names
post_SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient_multiple_imp[vars_impute] <- post_SISTRAT_imputed_only_df[vars_impute]

#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
# 5) OOB error summary → kable
#    (missRanger stores per-target OOB error in the "oob" attribute)
#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_#_
post_oob_vec <- attr(post_SISTRAT_imputed_only, "oob")
if (!is.null(post_oob_vec)) {
  post_df_oob <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(post_oob_vec),
    OOB_Error = round(as.numeric(post_oob_vec),3)
  )
  post_df_oob <- post_df_oob[order(post_df_oob$Variable), , drop = FALSE]
  knitr::kable(post_df_oob, format = "markdown", align = c("l","r"),
               col.names = c("Variable", "OOB error (1 - R² or class error)"))
} else {
  message("No OOB error attribute returned by missRanger.")
}
# |  |Variable              | OOB error (1 - R² or class error)|
# |:--|:--------------------|---------------------------------:|
# |3  |biopsych_comp_severe |                             0.779|
# |1  |prim_sub_daily       |                             0.839|
# |2  |sus_ini_mod_mvv      |                             0.344|

# post_oob_vec
# treat_lt_90        treat_log_days        prim_sub_daily biopsych_comp_severe       sus_ini_mod_mvv 
# 0.0008214128          0.3522101134          0.8405593966          0.7624347156          0.3418216406 

saveRDS(
  post_SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient_multiple_imp,
  file = file.path(wdpath, "data/20241015_out/psu", "post_SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient_multiple_imp.rds")
)
```

### Survival prep

```{r survival_prep}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hold"

# Censor date you specified
censor_date <- as.Date("2025-05-28")

post_SISTRAT_traj <-
  post_SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient_multiple_imp|>
  tidytable::ungroup()|> 
  # Canonical ordering within each patient
  tidytable::arrange(hash_key, adm_date_rec2, disch_date_rec6)|>
  tidytable::group_by(hash_key)|> 
  # Treatment sequence and entry date
  tidytable::mutate(
    treatment     = tidytable::row_number(),
    is_first_occurrence = tidytable::if_else(treatment == 1, 1, 0),
    max_treatment = max(treatment, na.rm = TRUE),
    enter_date    = min(adm_date_rec2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )|>
  tidytable::mutate(id = cumsum(is_first_occurrence))|>
  tidytable::ungroup()|>
  # Durations in MONTHS via lubridate::time_length (no 30.5 division)
  tidytable::mutate(
    time      = lubridate::time_length(lubridate::interval(enter_date, disch_date_rec6),  unit = "months"),
    cens_time = lubridate::time_length(lubridate::interval(enter_date, censor_date),       unit = "months")
  )|>
  # Tie-breaker for identical times within person: add small offsets 0.001, 0.002, ...
  tidytable::mutate(dup_idx = tidytable::row_number(), .by = c(hash_key, time))|>
  tidytable::mutate(time = time + (dup_idx - 1L) * 0.001)|>
  # Lag (optional diagnostic)
  tidytable::mutate(lag_time = tidytable::lag(time), .by = hash_key)|>
  # Survival time: use censoring if no event (tr_noncompletion == 0)
  tidytable::mutate(
    surv_time = tidytable::if_else(tidytable::coalesce(tr_noncompletion, 0L) == 0L, cens_time, time), 
    id = as.numeric(factor(hash_key))
  )|>
  # Clean up helper
  tidytable::select(-dup_idx, -is_first_occurrence)



# clean memory
gc()

# --- Prepare data: plain data.frame for IrregLong ---
post_sdat <- as.data.frame(post_SISTRAT_traj)

# ID as factor; time must be numeric; create visit indicator (every row is a visit)
post_sdat$id         <- as.numeric(factor(post_sdat$hash_key))
post_sdat$time       <- as.numeric(post_sdat$time)
post_sdat$event_vis  <- 1L

# Dummified vars
post_sdat$occ24_inactive <-  as.integer(post_sdat$occupation_condition_corr24 == "inactive")
post_sdat$occ24_unemployed <-  as.integer(post_sdat$occupation_condition_corr24 == "unemployed")
post_sdat$occ24_employed <-  as.integer(post_sdat$occupation_condition_corr24 == "employed")

post_sdat$susinidum_oh <-  as.integer(post_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "alcohol")
post_sdat$susinidum_coc <-  as.integer(post_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "cocaine powder")
post_sdat$susinidum_pbc <-  as.integer(post_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "cocaine paste")
post_sdat$susinidum_mar <-  as.integer(post_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "marijuana")
post_sdat$susinidum_oth <-  as.integer(post_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "others")

post_sdat$susprindum_oh <-  as.integer(post_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "alcohol")
post_sdat$susprindum_coc <-  as.integer(post_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "cocaine powder")
post_sdat$susprindum_pbc <-  as.integer(post_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "cocaine paste")
post_sdat$susprindum_mar <-  as.integer(post_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "marijuana")
post_sdat$susprindum_oth <-  as.integer(post_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "others")

post_sdat$year_c   <- post_sdat$year_decimal - 2015
post_sdat$age_c10  <- (post_sdat$adm_age_rec3 - mean(post_sdat$adm_age_rec3, na.rm=TRUE)) / 10

#Ensure treat_log_days exists, is numeric, and finite
#keep NA for non-positive so the lagger can handle it
stopifnot(post_sdat$treat_log_days[!is.finite(post_sdat$treat_log_days)]|> length()==0)

post_sdat$treat_log_days[!is.finite(post_sdat$treat_log_days)] <- NA_real_


post_sdat$tr_outcome <- as.integer(post_sdat$tr_noncompletion)

post_maxfu_df <- aggregate(cens_time ~ id, data = post_sdat, FUN = function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
names(post_maxfu_df) <- c("maxfu.id", "maxfu.time")
```


### Weighting

```{r weighting}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hold"

post_i0 <- IrregLong::iiw.weights(
  formulaph  = survival::Surv(time.lag, time, event_vis) ~ tr_outcome.lag + survival::cluster(id),
  # If you want stabilized weights, uncomment and provide a null model (often just cluster):
  # formulanull = ~ survival::cluster(id),
  data       = post_sdat,
  id         = "id",
  time       = "time",
  event      = "event_vis",           # each row is a visit
  lagvars    = c("time", "tr_outcome"),
  invariant  = "id",
  maxfu      = post_maxfu_df,             # per-ID maximum follow-up (same units as 'time': months)
  lagfirst   = c(0, 0),              # time.lag = 0 at first visit; tr_outcome.lag = 0 at first visit
  first      = TRUE                  # baseline visit observed with prob = 1
)

post_mf_all <- stats::model.frame(post_i0$m, data = post_i0$datacox, na.action = stats::na.pass)
post_keep_idx <- stats::complete.cases(post_mf_all)
post_drop_idx <- which(!post_keep_idx)

cat("Filtered without events with ties")
post_sdat_filt<- subset(post_sdat, !id %in% post_i0$datacox[which(!post_keep_idx),"id"])
post_maxfu_df_filt <- subset(post_maxfu_df, !maxfu.id %in% post_i0$datacox[which(!post_keep_idx),"id"])

post_i1_adj <- IrregLong::iiw.weights(
  formulaph  = survival::Surv(time.lag,time,event_vis) ~ 
    tr_noncompletion.lag+ biopsych_comp_severe.lag+ treat_lt_90.lag+ 
    treat_log_days.lag+ polysubstance_strict.lag+ 
    age_c10+ year_c+ 
    susinidum_oh+ susinidum_coc+ susinidum_pbc+ susinidum_mar+ 
    dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy+ dg_psiq_cie_10_dg+  prim_sub_daily+ 
    occ24_inactive+ occ24_unemployed+ 
    susprindum_oh+ susprindum_coc+ susprindum_pbc+ susprindum_mar+ 
    survival::cluster(id),
  # If you want stabilized weights, uncomment and provide a null model (often just cluster):
  # formulanull = ~ survival::cluster(id),
  data       = post_sdat,#[,model_vars],
  id         = "id",
  time       = "time",
  event      = "event_vis",           # each row is a visit
  lagvars= c("time", "tr_noncompletion", "biopsych_comp_severe", "treat_lt_90", "treat_log_days", "polysubstance_strict"),
  invariant  = "id",
  maxfu      = post_maxfu_df,             # per-ID maximum follow-up (same units as 'time': months)
  lagfirst   = c(5.149111,1,1,1,4.51086,1),              # time.lag = 0 at first visit; tr_outcome.lag = 0 at first visit  #90/30.5 4.51086 es 90 días
  first      = TRUE                  # baseline visit observed with prob = 1
)

# Call iiw.weights w/0s
post_i1_adj_0 <- IrregLong::iiw.weights(
  formulaph  = survival::Surv(time.lag, time, event_vis) ~
    tr_noncompletion.lag + biopsych_comp_severe.lag + treat_lt_90.lag +
    treat_log_days.lag + polysubstance_strict.lag +
    age_c10+ year_c+ 
    susinidum_oh + susinidum_coc + susinidum_pbc + susinidum_mar +
    dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy + dg_psiq_cie_10_dg + prim_sub_daily +
    occ24_inactive + occ24_unemployed +
    susprindum_oh + susprindum_coc + susprindum_pbc + susprindum_mar +
    survival::cluster(id),
  data       = post_sdat,
  id         = "id",
  time       = "time",
  event      = "event_vis",
  # include *all* variables you want lagged (and in the same order for lagfirst)
  lagvars    = c("time", "tr_noncompletion", "biopsych_comp_severe",
                 "treat_lt_90", "treat_log_days", "polysubstance_strict"),
  invariant  = "id",
  maxfu      = post_maxfu_df,
  # use zeros to avoid integer/double coercion warnings
  lagfirst   = c(5.149111/2, 0, 0, 0, 2.772589, 0),
   
  first      = TRUE
)
# In survival::Surv(time.lag, time, event_vis) :
#   Stop time must be > start time, NA created

## Start from i0$datacox
post_dat <- data.table::as.data.table(post_sdat)  # ensure data.table

invisible({
  
  ## Sort
  data.table::setorder(post_dat, id, time)
  
  ## Make intervals strictly positive & ordered
  eps <- 1e-3
  post_dat[, .idx := seq_len(.N) - 1L, by = .(id, time)]
  post_dat[, time := time + eps * .idx][, .idx := NULL]
  post_dat[, time.lag := data.table::shift(time, type = "lag", fill = 0), by = .(id)]
  post_dat[time <= time.lag, time := time.lag + eps]
  
  ## Lagged covariate with baseline = 0 (no NAs on first row)
  post_dat[, tr_outcome_lag0 := data.table::shift(tr_outcome, type = "lag"), by = .(id)]
  post_dat[is.na(tr_outcome_lag0), tr_outcome_lag0 := 0L]
  
  ## Per-id max follow-up (keep id types consistent)
  post_dat[, id := as.character(id)]
  post_maxfu_df <- post_dat[, .(maxfu.time = max(cens_time, na.rm = TRUE)),
                   by = .(maxfu.id = id)]
  
  post_dat[, id := as.character(id)]
  data.table::setDF(post_dat); post_maxfu_df <- as.data.frame(post_maxfu_df)

})
```

### Outcome analysis

```{r outcome_analysis}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hold"

post_res_by_plan0 <- tidy_iiw_by_plan(post_iiw_by_plan0, 
                                      digits = 2, 
                                      return_tidytable = TRUE)
post_res_by_plan1 <- tidy_iiw_by_plan(post_iiw_by_plan1, 
                                      digits = 2, 
                                      return_tidytable = TRUE)

post_tab3_w0<- 
  split(post_dat_with_weights_stab_cons, post_dat_with_weights_stab_cons$plan_type_mod)|>
  purrr::imap(~{
    df <- .x|> dplyr::mutate(id = as.character(id))
    
    # Clean formula: NO cluster()/strata()/id inside
    ff_local <- tr_noncompletion ~ polysubstance_strict +
      age_c10 + year_c +
      susinidum_oh + susinidum_coc + susinidum_pbc + susinidum_mar +
      dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy + dg_psiq_cie_10_dg +
      prim_sub_daily + occ24_inactive + occ24_unemployed +
      susprindum_coc + susprindum_pbc + susprindum_mar
    
    # Freeze row universe once
    mf0  <- stats::model.frame(ff_local, data = df, na.action = stats::na.pass)
    keep <- stats::complete.cases(mf0)
    mf   <- mf0[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(mf) == 0L) return(NULL)
    
    # Outcome variation check
    y <- stats::model.response(mf)
    if (length(unique(y)) < 2L) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows = nrow(mf),
        term = "(skipped: no outcome variation)",
        estimate = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    # Design matrix and term mapping
    X <- stats::model.matrix(ff_local, mf)
    assign_vec <- attr(X, "assign")                # maps columns -> term index
    term_labels <- attr(stats::terms(ff_local), "term.labels")
    
    # 1) Drop constant columns (except intercept)
    const <- vapply(as.data.frame(X), function(v) length(unique(v)) == 1L, logical(1))
    const[colnames(X) == "(Intercept)"] <- FALSE
    if (any(const)) {
      X <- X[, !const, drop = FALSE]
      assign_vec <- assign_vec[!const]
    }
    
    # 2) Drop collinear columns via QR
    qrX <- qr(X)
    keep_cols <- sort(qrX$pivot[seq_len(qrX$rank)])
    X_reduced <- X[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
    assign_kept <- assign_vec[keep_cols]
    
    # 3) Map kept columns back to ORIGINAL term labels
    kept_term_idx <- sort(unique(assign_kept[assign_kept > 0]))  # >0 skips intercept
    if (length(kept_term_idx) == 0L) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows = nrow(mf),
        term = "(no predictors after cleanup)",
        estimate = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    kept_terms <- term_labels[kept_term_idx]
    
    # 4) Rebuild reduced formula from ORIGINAL terms
    ff_reduced <- stats::reformulate(kept_terms, response = "tr_noncompletion")
    
    # 5) Align id to kept rows (same `keep` mask)
    id_vec <- df$id[keep]
    
    # 6) Fit GEE (intercept-only scale)
    fit <- geepack::geeglm(
      ff_reduced,
      id        = id_vec,
      data      = mf,
      family    = poisson,
      corstr    = "independence",
      scale.fix = TRUE,
      na.action = stats::na.exclude
      , weights = df$w0_tr[keep]   # or w1_tr, if you want weights by stratum
    )
    
    broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)|>
      dplyr::transmute(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows        = nrow(mf),
        term,
        `RR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
      )
  })|>
  dplyr::bind_rows()|>
  dplyr::relocate(plan_type_mod, n_rows)



post_tab3_w1<- 
  split(post_dat_with_weights_stab_cons, post_dat_with_weights_stab_cons$plan_type_mod)|>
```

## Complete case analyses 

```{r cc_prep_vars}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Filter for complete cases based on variables of interest
post2_SISTRAT_traj <-
  SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient_multiple[complete.cases(
    subset(
      SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient_multiple,
      select = c(vars_interest, "polysubstance_strict", "plan_type_mod")
    )
  ),]|>
  tidytable::ungroup()|> 
  # Canonical ordering within each patient
  tidytable::arrange(hash_key, adm_date_rec2, disch_date_rec6)|>
  tidytable::group_by(hash_key)|> 
  # Treatment sequence and entry date
  tidytable::mutate(
    treatment     = tidytable::row_number(),
    is_first_occurrence = tidytable::if_else(treatment == 1, 1, 0),
    max_treatment = max(treatment, na.rm = TRUE),
    enter_date    = min(adm_date_rec2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )|>
  tidytable::mutate(id = cumsum(is_first_occurrence))|>
  tidytable::ungroup()|>
  # Durations in MONTHS via lubridate::time_length (no 30.5 division)
  tidytable::mutate(
    time      = lubridate::time_length(lubridate::interval(enter_date, disch_date_rec6),  unit = "months"),
    cens_time = lubridate::time_length(lubridate::interval(enter_date, censor_date),       unit = "months")
  )|>
  # Tie-breaker for identical times within person: add small offsets 0.001, 0.002, ...
  tidytable::mutate(dup_idx = tidytable::row_number(), .by = c(hash_key, time))|>
  tidytable::mutate(time = time + (dup_idx - 1L) * 0.001)|>
  # Lag (optional diagnostic)
  tidytable::mutate(lag_time = tidytable::lag(time), .by = hash_key)|>
  # Survival time: use censoring if no event (tr_noncompletion == 0)
  tidytable::mutate(
    surv_time = tidytable::if_else(tidytable::coalesce(tr_noncompletion, 0L) == 0L, cens_time, time), 
    id = as.numeric(factor(hash_key))
  )|>
  # Clean up helper
  tidytable::select(-dup_idx, -is_first_occurrence)

# clean memory
gc()

# --- Prepare data: plain data.frame for IrregLong ---
post2_sdat <- as.data.frame(post2_SISTRAT_traj)

# ID as factor; time must be numeric; create visit indicator (every row is a visit)
post2_sdat$id         <- as.numeric(factor(post2_sdat$hash_key))
post2_sdat$time       <- as.numeric(post2_sdat$time)
post2_sdat$event_vis  <- 1L

# Dummified vars
post2_sdat$occ24_inactive <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$occupation_condition_corr24 == "inactive")
post2_sdat$occ24_unemployed <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$occupation_condition_corr24 == "unemployed")
post2_sdat$occ24_employed <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$occupation_condition_corr24 == "employed")

post2_sdat$susinidum_oh <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "alcohol")
post2_sdat$susinidum_coc <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "cocaine powder")
post2_sdat$susinidum_pbc <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "cocaine paste")
post2_sdat$susinidum_mar <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "marijuana")
post2_sdat$susinidum_oth <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$sus_ini_mod_mvv == "others")

post2_sdat$susprindum_oh <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "alcohol")
post2_sdat$susprindum_coc <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "cocaine powder")
post2_sdat$susprindum_pbc <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "cocaine paste")
post2_sdat$susprindum_mar <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "marijuana")
post2_sdat$susprindum_oth <-  as.integer(post2_sdat$primary_sub_mod == "others")

post2_sdat$year_c   <- post2_sdat$year_decimal - 2015
post2_sdat$age_c10  <- (post2_sdat$adm_age_rec3 - mean(post2_sdat$adm_age_rec3, na.rm=TRUE)) / 10

#Ensure treat_log_days exists, is numeric, and finite
#keep NA for non-positive so the lagger can handle it
stopifnot(post2_sdat$treat_log_days[!is.finite(post2_sdat$treat_log_days)]|> length()==0)

post2_sdat$treat_log_days[!is.finite(post2_sdat$treat_log_days)] <- NA_real_

post2_sdat$tr_outcome <- as.integer(post2_sdat$tr_noncompletion)

post2_maxfu_df <- aggregate(cens_time ~ id, data = post2_sdat, FUN = function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
names(post2_maxfu_df) <- c("maxfu.id", "maxfu.time")
```

### Initial Weighting and Refit

This chunk runs the initial `iiw.weights` and the refined version handling time lags and ties.

```{r cc_weighting_base}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hold"

post2_i0 <- IrregLong::iiw.weights(
  formulaph  = survival::Surv(time.lag, time, event_vis) ~ tr_outcome.lag + survival::cluster(id),
  data       = post2_sdat,
  id         = "id",
  time       = "time",
  event      = "event_vis",           # each row is a visit
  lagvars    = c("time", "tr_outcome"),
  invariant  = "id",
  maxfu      = post2_maxfu_df,             # per-ID maximum follow-up (same units as 'time': months)
  lagfirst   = c(0, 0),              # time.lag = 0 at first visit; tr_outcome.lag = 0 at first visit
  first      = TRUE                  # baseline visit observed with prob = 1
)

post2_mf_all <- stats::model.frame(post2_i0$m, data = post2_i0$datacox, na.action = stats::na.pass)
post2_keep_idx <- stats::complete.cases(post2_mf_all)
post2_drop_idx <- which(!post2_keep_idx)

cat("Filtered without events with ties\n")
post2_sdat_filt<- subset(post2_sdat, !id %in% post2_i0$datacox[which(!post2_keep_idx),"id"])
post2_maxfu_df_filt <- subset(post2_maxfu_df, !maxfu.id %in% post2_i0$datacox[which(!post2_keep_idx),"id"])

## Start from i0$datacox for REFIT
post2_dat <- data.table::as.data.table(post2_sdat)  # ensure data.table

## Sort
data.table::setorder(post2_dat, id, time)

## Make intervals strictly positive & ordered
eps <- 1e-3
post2_dat[, .idx := seq_len(.N) - 1L, by = .(id, time)]
post2_dat[, time := time + eps * .idx][, .idx := NULL]
post2_dat[, time.lag := data.table::shift(time, type = "lag", fill = 0), by = .(id)]
post2_dat[time <= time.lag, time := time.lag + eps]

## Lagged covariate with baseline = 0 (no NAs on first row)
post2_dat[, tr_outcome_lag0 := data.table::shift(tr_outcome, type = "lag"), by = .(id)]
post2_dat[is.na(tr_outcome_lag0), tr_outcome_lag0 := 0L]

## Per-id max follow-up (keep id types consistent)
post2_dat[, id := as.character(id)]
post2_maxfu_df <- post2_dat[, .(maxfu.time = max(cens_time, na.rm = TRUE)),
                            by = .(maxfu.id = id)]

post2_dat[, id := as.character(id)]
data.table::setDF(post2_dat); post2_maxfu_df <- as.data.frame(post2_maxfu_df)

## Refit: only let IrregLong lag time; use our tr_outcome_lag0 in the formula
post2_i0_3 <- IrregLong::iiw.weights(
  formulaph  = survival::Surv(time.lag, time, event_vis) ~ tr_outcome_lag0 + 
    survival::cluster(id),
  data       = post2_dat,
  id         = "id",
  time       = "time",
  event      = "event_vis",
  lagvars    = c("time"),   # we already created tr_outcome_lag0
  invariant  = "id",
  maxfu      = post2_maxfu_df,
  lagfirst   = c(0),        # first time.lag = 0
  first      = TRUE
)
sum(is.na(post2_i0_3$iiw.weight))
```

### Stratified Weighting Calculation

This calculates the weights per plan type.

```{r cc_weighting_strat}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hold"

post2_iiw_by_plan0 <- lapply(plan_types, function(pt) {
  cat("Running for:", pt, "\n")
  # Subset as plain data.frame
  post2_dat_sub <- post2_dat |> dplyr::filter(plan_type_mod == pt) |> as.data.frame()
  # Subset maxfu_df to only the ids in dat_sub
  post2_maxfu_sub <- post2_maxfu_df[post2_maxfu_df$maxfu.id %in% dat_sub$id, , drop = FALSE]
  IrregLong::iiw.weights(
    formulaph  = survival::Surv(time.lag, time, event_vis) ~ 
      tr_noncompletion.lag + biopsych_comp_severe.lag + 
      treat_lt_90.lag + treat_log_days.lag + polysubstance_strict.lag +
      age_c10 + year_c +
      susinidum_oh + susinidum_coc + susinidum_pbc + susinidum_mar +
      dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy + dg_psiq_cie_10_dg + prim_sub_daily +
      occ24_inactive + occ24_unemployed +
      susprindum_oh + susprindum_coc + susprindum_pbc + susprindum_mar +
      survival::cluster(id),
    data       = post2_dat_sub,
    id         = "id",
    time       = "time",
    event      = "event_vis",
    lagvars    = c("time", "tr_noncompletion", "biopsych_comp_severe",
                   "treat_lt_90", "treat_log_days", "polysubstance_strict"),
    invariant  = "id",
    maxfu      = post2_maxfu_sub,  # stratified by subset IDs
    lagfirst   = c(5.149111, 0, 0, 0, 2.772589, 0),
    first      = TRUE
  )
})
names(post2_iiw_by_plan0) <- plan_types

names(post2_iiw_by_plan1) <- plan_types
```

### Stabilization and Merging

This extracts the weights, handles NAs for the first treatment, creates the summary table, and applies truncation/capping.


### Modeling and Results

This fits the GEE models for both weight sets and produces the final stratified results table.

```{r cc_models_results}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

post2_res_by_plan0 <- tidy_iiw_by_plan(post2_iiw_by_plan0, 
                                     digits = 2, 
                                     return_tidytable = TRUE)
post2_res_by_plan1 <- tidy_iiw_by_plan(post2_iiw_by_plan1, 
                                     digits = 2, 
                                     return_tidytable = TRUE)


post2_tab3_w0<- 
  split(post2_dat_with_weights_stab_cons, post2_dat_with_weights_stab_cons$plan_type_mod)|>
  purrr::imap(~{
    df <- .x|> dplyr::mutate(id = as.character(id))
    
    # Clean formula: NO cluster()/strata()/id inside
    ff_local <- tr_noncompletion ~ polysubstance_strict +
      age_c10 + year_c +
      susinidum_oh + susinidum_coc + susinidum_pbc + susinidum_mar +
      dg_psiq_cie_10_instudy + dg_psiq_cie_10_dg +
      prim_sub_daily + occ24_inactive + occ24_unemployed +
      susprindum_coc + susprindum_pbc + susprindum_mar
    
    # Freeze row universe once
    mf0  <- stats::model.frame(ff_local, data = df, na.action = stats::na.pass)
    keep <- stats::complete.cases(mf0)
    mf   <- mf0[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(mf) == 0L) return(NULL)
    
    # Outcome variation check
    y <- stats::model.response(mf)
    if (length(unique(y)) < 2L) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows = nrow(mf),
        term = "(skipped: no outcome variation)",
        estimate = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    # Design matrix and term mapping
    X <- stats::model.matrix(ff_local, mf)
    assign_vec <- attr(X, "assign")                 # maps columns -> term index
    term_labels <- attr(stats::terms(ff_local), "term.labels")
    
    # 1) Drop constant columns (except intercept)
    const <- vapply(as.data.frame(X), function(v) length(unique(v)) == 1L, logical(1))
    const[colnames(X) == "(Intercept)"] <- FALSE
    if (any(const)) {
      X <- X[, !const, drop = FALSE]
      assign_vec <- assign_vec[!const]
    }
    
    # 2) Drop collinear columns via QR
    qrX <- qr(X)
    keep_cols <- sort(qrX$pivot[seq_len(qrX$rank)])
    X_reduced <- X[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
    assign_kept <- assign_vec[keep_cols]
    
    # 3) Map kept columns back to ORIGINAL term labels
    kept_term_idx <- sort(unique(assign_kept[assign_kept > 0]))  # >0 skips intercept
    if (length(kept_term_idx) == 0L) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows = nrow(mf),
        term = "(no predictors after cleanup)",
        estimate = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    kept_terms <- term_labels[kept_term_idx]
    
    # 4) Rebuild reduced formula from ORIGINAL terms
    ff_reduced <- stats::reformulate(kept_terms, response = "tr_noncompletion")
    
    # 5) Align id to kept rows (same `keep` mask)
    id_vec <- df$id[keep]
    
    # 6) Fit GEE (intercept-only scale)
    fit <- geepack::geeglm(
      ff_reduced,
      id        = id_vec,
      data      = mf,
      family    = poisson,
      corstr    = "independence",
      scale.fix = TRUE,
      na.action = stats::na.exclude
      , weights = df$w0_tr[keep]   # or w1_tr, if you want weights by stratum
    )
    
    broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)|>
      dplyr::transmute(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows        = nrow(mf),
        term,
        `RR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
      )
  })|>
  dplyr::bind_rows()|>
  dplyr::relocate(plan_type_mod, n_rows)



post2_tab3_w1<- 
  split(post2_dat_with_weights_stab_cons, post2_dat_with_weights_stab_cons$plan_type_mod)|>
  purrr::imap(~{
    df <- .x|> dplyr::mutate(id = as.character(id))
    
    # Clean formula: NO cluster()/strata()/id inside
    ff_local <- tr_noncompletion ~ polysubstance_strict +
      age_c10 + year_c +

      prim_sub_daily + occ24_inactive + occ24_unemployed +
      susprindum_coc + susprindum_pbc + susprindum_mar
    
    # Freeze row universe once
    mf0  <- stats::model.frame(ff_local, data = df, na.action = stats::na.pass)
    keep <- stats::complete.cases(mf0)
    mf   <- mf0[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(mf) == 0L) return(NULL)
    
    # Outcome variation check
    y <- stats::model.response(mf)
    if (length(unique(y)) < 2L) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows = nrow(mf),
        term = "(skipped: no outcome variation)",
        estimate = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    # Design matrix and term mapping
    X <- stats::model.matrix(ff_local, mf)
    assign_vec <- attr(X, "assign")                 # maps columns -> term index
    term_labels <- attr(stats::terms(ff_local), "term.labels")
    
    # 1) Drop constant columns (except intercept)
    const <- vapply(as.data.frame(X), function(v) length(unique(v)) == 1L, logical(1))
    const[colnames(X) == "(Intercept)"] <- FALSE
    if (any(const)) {
      X <- X[, !const, drop = FALSE]
      assign_vec <- assign_vec[!const]
    }
    
    # 2) Drop collinear columns via QR
    qrX <- qr(X)
    keep_cols <- sort(qrX$pivot[seq_len(qrX$rank)])
    X_reduced <- X[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
    assign_kept <- assign_vec[keep_cols]
    
    # 3) Map kept columns back to ORIGINAL term labels
    kept_term_idx <- sort(unique(assign_kept[assign_kept > 0]))  # >0 skips intercept
    if (length(kept_term_idx) == 0L) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows = nrow(mf),
        term = "(no predictors after cleanup)",
        estimate = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    kept_terms <- term_labels[kept_term_idx]
    
    # 4) Rebuild reduced formula from ORIGINAL terms
    ff_reduced <- stats::reformulate(kept_terms, response = "tr_noncompletion")
    
    # 5) Align id to kept rows (same `keep` mask)
    id_vec <- df$id[keep]
    
    # 6) Fit GEE (intercept-only scale)
    fit <- geepack::geeglm(
      ff_reduced,
      id        = id_vec,
      data      = mf,
      family    = poisson,
      corstr    = "independence",
      scale.fix = TRUE,
      na.action = stats::na.exclude
      , weights = df$w1_tr[keep]   # or w1_tr, if you want weights by stratum
    )
    
    broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)|>
      dplyr::transmute(
        plan_type_mod = as.character(.y),
        n_rows        = nrow(mf),
        term,
        `RR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
      )
  })|>
  dplyr::bind_rows()|>
  dplyr::relocate(plan_type_mod, n_rows)

# Combine and Export Results
rbind.data.frame(
  cbind.data.frame(w="weight lag=0", dplyr::filter(post2_tab3_w0, grepl("poly", term))),
  cbind.data.frame(w="weight lag=1", dplyr::filter(post2_tab3_w1, grepl("poly", term)))
)|> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = w,
    values_from = `RR (95% CI)`
  )|>
  dplyr::relocate(plan_type_mod, n_rows, term)|> 
  dplyr::select(-term)|> 
  (\(df) {
    cat(paste0("Total cases included in the model: ",
               formatC(dplyr::summarise(df, sum_n= sum(n_rows))|> dplyr::pull(sum_n), big.mark = ","), "\n"))
    utils::write.csv(df, file.path(wdpath, "data/20241015_out/psu", "stratified_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    df ->> post2_stratified_results
    df
  })()|>
  knitr::kable("markdown", caption= "Stratified models by Plan Type", digits = 2)
```

```{r weight_analysis}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define Helper Functions for SMD
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
calculate_smd_safe <- function(p1, p2) {
  # Check if values are valid probabilities
  if (p1 < 0 || p1 > 1 || p2 < 0 || p2 > 1) return(NA)
  
  # Variance for proportions
  v1 <- p1 * (1 - p1)
  v2 <- p2 * (1 - p2)
  
  # Pooled Standard Deviation
  pooled_sd <- sqrt((v1 + v2) / 2)
  
  # Safety check
  if (is.na(pooled_sd) || pooled_sd == 0) return(0)
  
  return((p1 - p2) / pooled_sd)
}

calc_continuous_smd <- function(m1, m2, s1, s2) {
  pooled_sd <- sqrt((s1^2 + s2^2) / 2)
  return((m1 - m2) / pooled_sd)
}

# Transpose and clean names
df_compare0 <- as.data.frame(t(comparison_w0_extreme_wgts))
df_compare1 <- as.data.frame(t(comparison_w1_extreme_wgts))

# Assuming alphabetical order of groups: 1="Very high weight", 2="Very low weight"
colnames(df_compare1) <- c("Very high weight", "Very low weight")
colnames(df_compare0) <- c("Very high weight", "Very low weight")

# Convert columns to numeric and drop first 2 rows (Group label and N)
df_compare1$`Very high weight` <- as.numeric(as.character(df_compare1$`Very high weight`))
df_compare1$`Very low weight` <- as.numeric(as.character(df_compare1$`Very low weight`))
df_compare1 <- df_compare1[3:nrow(df_compare1),]

df_compare0$`Very high weight` <- as.numeric(as.character(df_compare0$`Very high weight`))
df_compare0$`Very low weight` <- as.numeric(as.character(df_compare0$`Very low weight`))
df_compare0 <- df_compare0[3:nrow(df_compare0),]

# Calculate Binary SMDs
df_compare1$SMD <- mapply(calculate_smd_safe, df_compare1$`Very high weight`, df_compare1$`Very low weight`)
df_compare0$SMD <- mapply(calculate_smd_safe, df_compare0$`Very high weight`, df_compare0$`Very low weight`)

# Calculate Continuous SMDs
# Note: Using index 1 for High, 2 for Low based on alphabetical sort order
smd_age1  <- calc_continuous_smd(comparison_w1_extreme_wgts$age[1], comparison_w1_extreme_wgts$age[2], comparison_w1_extreme_wgts$sd_age[1], comparison_w1_extreme_wgts$sd_age[2])

# Insert Continuous SMDs
df_compare1$SMD[rownames(df_compare1) == "age"] <- smd_age1
df_compare1$SMD[rownames(df_compare1) == "year_cen"] <- smd_year1
df_compare1$SMD[rownames(df_compare1) == "time"] <- smd_time1

df_compare0$SMD[rownames(df_compare0) == "age"] <- smd_age0
df_compare0$SMD[rownames(df_compare0) == "year_cen"] <- smd_year0
df_compare0$SMD[rownames(df_compare0) == "time"] <- smd_time0

# Remove SD rows
df_compare1 <- df_compare1[!grepl("sd_", rownames(df_compare1)),]
df_compare0 <- df_compare0[!grepl("sd_", rownames(df_compare0)),]

# Final formatting
continuous_vars <- c("age", "year_cen", "time")
df_compare0$Var <- rownames(df_compare0)

df_fmt <- dplyr::bind_cols(df_compare0, df_compare1) |>
  janitor::clean_names() %>%

             sprintf("%1.2f", .), 
             sprintf("%.1f%%", . * 100))
  )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(smd_3, smd_7), ~ sprintf("%1.2f", abs(.)))) |>
  dplyr::select(var, everything())

# Display
knitr::kable(df_fmt, caption = "Comparison of extreme weight groups (Lag 0 vs Lag 1)")
```
